provenance: Original generated raster art via built-in image_gen. User-approved original concept used as visual reference. No third-party game assets. No separate license grant implied.
rendering: nearest-neighbor only, integer scene scale recommended
limitations: AI-generated pixel-style source, not hand-authored exact palette/grid. Logical exports are nearest-neighbor normalized, not native pixel generation.
Source sheet spacing is imperfect; explicit crop regions recorded rather than claiming perfectly uniform source cells.
Minor pose/volume variation remains, especially golem pickaxe handedness; the original prototype golem motion is intentionally limited.
Dwarf strike contains baked-in slash; do not double-add equivalent effect. Tiny slash tip clipped at frame region boundary.
Background is two independent generated layers, not a sliced screenshot. The A01 far layer contains static cave rim and bridge together; no independent bridge parallax.
A01 golem uses approved amber-core mining golem prototype although written lore describes its lamp extinguished.
Enemy death is one distinct held collapse frame, not a multi-frame fall.
New humanoid attack frames have minor hand/axe pose drift. Shield captain shield is on right side of picture, not left-facing front.
Use sprite.healthBarAnchor or idle solidBBox, not alphaBBox, for stationary overhead health/shield overlay. alphaBBox contains invisible source dust.
The original green lizard prototype remains unmapped. Explicit production identity coverage now spans A01-A04; A05-A10 are not yet covered.

Hero weapon coverage only axe and hammer; other families must fallback honestly. Hammer strike includes baked gold impact sparks, not an elemental damage claim. Hero death is held collapsed pose, not alpha-only removal.
coveragePolicy: Only explicit monsterSprites AND areaBackgrounds mappings are allowed; missing coverage must use legacy renderer, never index/modulo or generic substitution.

actorVariants.reason: Production followers retain elite definitionId; name 褐背幼蜥. Visual-only juvenile derivation from brown-rock-lizard, 65% size.
